title: Two Initials in the Ironwork

hints.text: Stand outside near Pirates of the Caribbean and look up toward the balcony ironwork.
Do not search for a printed sign. The tribute is worked into the decorative railing itself.
Look for the initials WD and RD hidden in the balcony railing above the Pirates area.

revealDescription: The balcony railing includes WD and RD, honoring Walt Disney and Roy Disney in the space originally planned as a private family apartment.
